root_cause: Up to ten sequential Netlify Blob/Supabase/webhook read-write roundtrips per cron invocation exceeded observed ~15-second edge-request client cutoff; full-store list() and event-first ordering increased read cost and outcome starvation. HTTP 499 does not prove server-side rollback.
prevention_rule: Budget every scheduled replay before starting another external side effect; use paginated Blob listing, fair event/outcome priority and durable per-item idempotency/readback. Respect provider receipt even when HTTP observer times out. Do not mark delivery complete without provider acknowledgment.

test_evidence.provider_observation: Netlify 2026-10-19: growth-drain 1316 HTTP499/1422 HTTP204, P99 ~15s; observation includes function log after 499
